headline: Eleven leans into the glass.
body: A bus sighs at the corner and does not take anyone. The shopfront reflects the desk lamp back at itself. We keep the copy short so the hour can finish speaking.

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one window still warm above the chemist

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet stone, a bicycle left unlocked

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the room agreeing to stay awake
